correctness.rationale: For normal-angle support R+a cos 3theta+b cos(5theta+phi), R>8a+24b ensures strict curvature positivity and constant width. Differentiating the antipodal midpoint produces Wigner speed -8a[cos 3theta+lambda cos(5theta+phi)] times unit tangent, lambda=3b/a. Simultaneous q=qprime=0 gives 9/25<=lambda²<=1, with all intermediate collision phases phi=2kpi/3±delta(lambda) and delta increasing from zero to pi/3. Sign analysis at phi=0 and pi/3 plus collision exclusion proves three-vs-five ordinary parameter counts. Higher multiplicities at lambda=3/5 and 1 arise from qsecond and qthird. Area Fourier orthogonality yields eta=lambda²/(3+lambda²), hence sharp 3/28 and 1/4 thresholds with the stated strict qualifications. Independent direct 20,000-grid sign-change checks at lambda 0.4,0.7 and 1.2 and phases 0,pi/3,0.2 corroborated representative counts; analytic arguments, not finite grids, prove all parameters.
